Historical models, live control

Bell Labs’ 1961 “Daisy Bell” used an early digital vocal-tract model. Bellazoid keeps that lineage alive; CMU Flite’s KAL16 voice supplies rendered phone and pair units. Voxazoid follows their moving spectrum through twenty speech bands. Typing supplies the control gestures.
